Messages.Author: dalefi
Messages.Body:
Does pressing to end at any point while this card still has counters on it end combat completely?

[Combat]
Trap
Only usable before range is determined during the first round of combat.
Put this card in play with 3 counters. Each time a card is played this combat, reset the number of counters on this card to 3. During the press step of each round this combat, this Trap automatically burns 1 counter from itself to provide 1 press to continue combat (either combatant can press to end combat). Burn this card at the end of combat.

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
you always can use other press to continue if the opposing player use a press to end the combat, the automatic press of Trap always happen, even when you don't want to continue combat anymore, in this case you can press to end

David Resende - Prince of Teresina

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> dalefi wrote:
> Does pressing to end at any point while this card still has counters on it end combat completely?
>
During the press step, Trap provides a mandatory press to continue. Any player involved in combat can then uses presses to end the combat, and if one does, the other one can play a press to continue etc.
